overview_description.description:
Osh's Affordable Pharmceuticals produces generic drugs at low prices. It connects patients with pharmacies that sells low-cost medicines. 

Alex Oshmyansky founded Osh's Affordable Pharmaceuticals in 2016. Its headquarters is in Fremont in California.
